description: Shared frontend/backend fixtures for the owner's explicit publication of a deck (Share/8, #430): who may read the published revision (access level), the publication metadata (topic from a two-level directory, content and target language, level, up to five tags), the release note, the «Публичная» checklist and the topic directory. Owner only (learning.read for GET, learning.write for PUT); a foreign or deleted deck is the same opaque 404 as everywhere. Publishing never creates a deck revision and never changes deck.row_version: an open editor gets no 412. `invariants` are executable: the integration tests compare real answers with the property sets of these examples.

constants.levelsNote: one closed list: CEFR for languages and exams, the three words for everything else; the server does not tie a level to a topic
constants.tagAlphabet: letters, digits, space, '-', '_', '+', '#', '.'; trimmed, NFKC, lowercase, inner whitespace collapsed to one space; duplicates after normalization are 400
constants.versionWire: rowVersion and the ETag are the stored row version plus one; "0" means the deck has no publication row yet (it never left «Приватная» and nothing was saved)

catalogThreshold.note: informational: a deck below the threshold is public by link and in the author's profile but not in the catalog (catalog epic); it never blocks the checklist

constants.identityClaimNote: boolean claim of the Identity /userinfo answer (consent on, account active, login set); the one name both services read from this file in their tests

invariants: owner only: a foreign, absent or deleted deck is the opaque 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND on GET and PUT; GET needs learning.read, PUT needs learning.write
every answer is Cache-Control: private, no-store; GET carries ETag = quoted rowVersion; a fresh PUT carries the ETag of the new version; a replayed PUT carries no ETag and Idempotency-Replayed: true
PUT needs exactly one If-Match: a quoted canonical decimal (missing 428, malformed 400, stale 412 VERSION_CONFLICT); "0" is the version of a deck without a publication row
PUT is idempotent by commandId (house receipts: actor, command type, deck, expected version and the whole body are bound; a used commandId with other input is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT)
a PUT whose resulting state equals the stored one writes nothing: rowVersion, publishedAt and the event outbox do not move (changed: false)
publishing never creates a deck revision and never changes deck.row_version
`publish` moves publishedRevisionId to the deck's current head; expectedHeadRevisionId must be that head, otherwise 412 VERSION_CONFLICT (the client re-reads)

leaving PRIVATE for the first time requires `publish` (the first publication happens on leaving «Приватная»): without a published revision and without `publish` the answer is 400 PUBLICATION_REQUIRED; `publish` together with visibility PRIVATE is 400 INVALID_REQUEST

becoming PUBLIC (from any other level) requires the published revision to be the head or `publish` in the same command, otherwise 400 PUBLICATION_REQUIRED: the non-commercial media check judges the head, readers get the published revision; GET still lists blockedMedia of the head for the UI

a resulting level PUBLIC requires the checklist: non-empty description of the revision readers get, a topic, a content language, a public profile ready in Identity (claim mnema_public_profile of /userinfo) and no non-commercial stock media in the deck head; otherwise 409 PUBLICATION_REQUIREMENTS with `failed` listing the checklist keys; the catalog threshold never blocks. The public profile and the media items gate only the exposure (becoming PUBLIC, or `publish` while PUBLIC): a benign edit of a public deck (tags, requestsEnabled, topic, language) is not blocked by a withdrawn consent. Withdrawal hides the author at once in Identity; demoting the deck itself is an open owner decision

every effective write whose resulting level is PUBLIC (metadata, tags, requestsEnabled included) appends one deck_publication_event, so the catalog projector never misses a metadata edit; a no-op appends none

any move to a more restrictive level rotates the public code (PUBLIC > LINK > INVITE > PRIVATE, every step down); raising the level or keeping it keeps the code; a PRIVATE deck reports publicCode null and link null
every effective change of the level or of the published revision appends one row to the deck_publication_event outbox (nothing consumes it before the catalog epic)

unpublishedChanges is the number of distinct materials plus distinct exercises changed in the deck journal after the published revision, null while the deck was never published; headRevisionId differing from publishedRevisionId with 0 changes means a title or description edit only
metadata.topicId must be a selectable topic: a leaf of the directory (a top-level topic without children, «Другое», is a leaf); unknown or non-leaf is 400
suggested never writes anything: it is the detector's guess for the UI to pre-fill (contentLanguage null when unsure, at most three topicIds ordered by score)
the topic directory is authenticated, static data: names in Russian and English, two levels, siblings ordered by ordinal

blocked.note: stock media under a non-commercial license in the head: blockedMedia names the material or exercise that uses it; the level cannot be PUBLIC until it is replaced

requestNoPublish.note: a metadata/level change without moving the published revision

put.replayNote: an exact retry returns the original acknowledgement body with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag; the embedded publication is the state at the time of the command, so the client re-reads with GET before editing further

publicationRequired.title: Publication required
publicationRequired.detail: The deck must publish its current head: for its first publication and for becoming public.

publicationRequirements.title: Publication requirements not met
publicationRequirements.detail: The deck does not meet the requirements of a public deck.

staleVersion.title: Version conflict
staleVersion.detail: The resource changed after the supplied version was read.
staleVersion.note: the same answer for a stale If-Match and for a stale expectedHeadRevisionId

topics.note: the real directory is longer; a top-level entry with an empty `children` is itself selectable («Другое»)

ownerDeck.note: the owner's own deck JSON (detail, list, acknowledgements of contracts/decks/metadata.json) reports the real level from the publication row, lowercase: private | invite | link | public
